about: Offline wait:"sent" contracts (BE-3929): a linked Solana trade's POST /api/v1/trade/agent/submit with wait "sent" answers HTTP 202 (status broadcast, signature, clientTradeId) once the RPC acknowledges the send, and Candle books it in the background; the trading-background-booking worker books any the request did not, once, with zero double-booking and zero lost fees. Recorded by running Candle's own broadcaster, confirm loop, Solana wire checks, pre-send record rules, confirmSolanaTrade booking races, worker pass and worker confirm against stand-ins, with the route's checks pinned as source text, and the SDK and CLI through their own code, from the source commit named below (CLI 0.13.47, MCP 0.10.45, SDK 0.6.39); every fetch is intercepted and no database is used.
